This is a legitimate build system modification that switches from static to shared library linking for Linux platforms. The changes are standard practice in modern PostgreSQL builds and do not introduce any new functionality, network connections, or system modifications beyond the build configuration. There is no evidence of supply chain attacks, backdoors, or malicious code injection. The patch only affects how the build system links against the libpq library and whether header files are included during compilation.

The modifications are safe and consistent with normal AUR packaging practices for source-based packages. The patch follows expected patterns for adjusting build flags and does not execute any external commands or modify system files outside the build process.
</details>
